english: You will complete your mission in life when you figure out what your mission in life is. Your purpose is to discover your purpose. This is not a paradox. This is the way.
persian: مأموریت زندگی‌ت وقتی کامل می‌شه که بفهمی مأموریتت چیه. هدفت اینه که هدفت رو پیدا کنی. این تناقض نیست؛ راه همینه.
coreMeaning: The search to discover one's own purpose is itself meaningful life work. The journey of asking, testing and learning is the mission, rather than wasted time before the mission.

ideas.centralDevice: A solemn mission envelope contains the instruction to discover one's own path; opening it leads directly to active exploration.
ideas.risk: Avoid a boss or external authority assigning a predetermined purpose.

ideas.titleFa: نقشه‌ای که با قدم‌ها ساخته می‌شود
ideas.centralDevice: A blank map gains one's own path through lived experiments, with no treasure or wealth destination.
ideas.risk: Prevent a generic travel interpretation; the map is explicitly the character's own life path.

ideas.centralDevice: A character wondering what their life book is about fills it with lived experiments, then discovers the title is the search for their own path.
ideas.risk: Activities are ordinary noncommercial experiences, not a job-choice test.

ideas.centralDevice: A seeker with a notebook of experiments asks when their real mission will start; a friend points out that discovering their own path was already the mission.
ideas.risk: The completed notebook must clearly contain active lived experiences rather than an empty plan.
